daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Pisces. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower rn. The universe is whispering something important, so pause and listen before you react.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a gentle invitation to be more vulnerable today. Real connections happen when you drop the act and show up as you actually are. Someone notices.
daily.career: Creative energy is flowing, but don't let perfectionism kill your vibe. Start that project even if it's messy—momentum matters more than polish right now. Your unique perspective is literally what people need.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a bit overstimulated, so lean into grounding activities. Touch grass, take a bath, journal—whatever helps you feel rooted. Your body's asking for gentleness, not intensity.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your zone of self-expression, Pisces. This week invites you to speak your truth without apologizing. Trust the quiet knowing that's been building inside you—it's been trying to get your attention.
weekly.love: Venus is asking you to be vulnerable in a way that feels scary but necessary. Whether you're single or coupled, authentic connection thrives when you show up as yourself. Let someone see the real you this week.
